content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is marked as confidential or that would be reasonably considered confidential by a person of ordinary prudence.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS_OF_THE_RECEIVING_PARTY
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.2_EXCLUSIONS
content_blocks.text: The obligations set forth in this Section 2 do not apply to information that the Receiving Party can prove was already known to it at the time of disclosure, or that becomes publicly known through no fault of the Receiving Party.
